description: Dependency update pull requests into dev. Every version waits 7 days after its release, and a human merges each pull request.

customManagers.description: Images pinned as name:tag@digest where no built-in manager looks: ci tools, the baseline allowlist, kind nodes
Chart versions in scripts, each annotated with a # renovate: comment

packageRules.description: Our own image and repository, built by ci and promoted by pull request, have no upstream to follow
A new major version is a decision, not a routine update: it waits for approval on the dependency dashboard
Build and runtime node move together; the distroless runtime has no package list, so this is what keeps its node patched
The baseline allowlist must hold the same postgres digest as the api chart's setup job
prBodyNotes: The baseline chart's `allowedImages` must keep the same digest as the api chart's `database.setup.image`; this pull request changes both.

packageRules.description: Upstream charts whose values files pin image digests by hand, after a signature check
prBodyNotes: This chart's values file pins its images by digest. Before merging, move those digests to the images of the new chart version and verify their signatures with cosign; otherwise the old images keep running.
